title: Suffix Boxes
rule: A suffix is an ending added to a base word, like ed, ing, ly, er, est, ful, less, ness, or s and es. Draw a box around the whole suffix.
trickText: Find the base word first. Take the ending off: is what is left a real word? Then it is a suffix. Box only the ending.
say: Today's case: suffixes. A suffix is an ending added to a base word. Take the ending off and check that a real word is left. Then put a box around the ending.

example.answer: j u m p e# d#
example.say: Look at jumped. The base word is jump. The ending e d was added. So I put a box around e d.

activities.instruction: Find the base word. Then box the suffix.
